title: Amendment record for archkeel validate --against widening
$comment: Written and read by `archkeel validate --against <ref> --amendment <path>` (AD-61, #11). Binds one exact before/after contract digest pair, computed with archkeel.ir.codec.contract_digest, so an amendment written for one change cannot silently authorise a different one.

schema_version.description: The only amendment schema this Archkeel reads.

before_digest.description: SHA-256 of the --against revision's contract, in the canonical form archkeel.ir.codec.contract_bytes writes; the SHA-256 of no bytes when that revision holds no contract at the configured path (AD-104).

after_digest.description: SHA-256 of the contract being validated, in the same canonical form.

decided_by.description: Free text: who decided this widening is allowed.

rationale.description: Free text: why the widening was decided.
